config._comment: Project-wide settings used by the build and the web app. Travel-time parameters are estimates (تقديرية) — the operator does not publish inter-station run times. Fares/hours are public operator information as of 2026; verify in the darb app.

note.ar: أوقات التشغيل المعلنة قد تتغير في رمضان والأعياد — راجع تطبيق درب. آخر قطار في اتجاهك قد يغادر قبل موعد الإغلاق.
note.en: Hours change during Ramadan and on holidays — check the darb app. The last train in your direction may leave before closing time.

note.ar: تذكرة واحدة تغطي أي عدد من الرحلات والتبديلات خلال مدتها على المترو وحافلات الرياض. الأطفال دون 6 سنوات مجاناً مع شخص بالغ. الدفع ببطاقة درب أو تطبيق درب أو بطاقة بنكية لاتلامسية. للاسترشاد فقط — تحقّق من الأسعار الحالية في تطبيق درب.
note.en: One ticket covers any number of rides and transfers within its validity on the metro and Riyadh buses. Children under 6 travel free with an adult. Pay with a darb card, the darb app or a contactless bank card. Indicative only — verify current fares in the darb app.

places._comment: Well-known destinations (أماكن) that people search for, each resolved to the nearest metro station(s) at build time. Coordinates are approximate (±100–300 m, 'approx': true) — they come from general knowledge and are meant to pick the right station, not to navigate to a door. 'station' pins a specific station when the place sits at its exit; otherwise the nearest stations are computed. Add or correct entries freely: `npm run build` regenerates everything.

schematic._comment: Hand-designed schematic (diagrammatic) layout of the network: an octilinear grid (segments are horizontal, vertical or 45°). x grows eastward, y grows southward, 1 unit = `unit` px. Each station: [x, y, label, overrides]. label = where the name sits relative to the station: E/W = horizontal text beside the station (used on vertical and diagonal segments); N/S = text rotated −45° above-right / below-left (used on horizontal segments); n/s = horizontal text centred above/below. overrides may hold {text:{en,ar}} with \n for a two-line label and dx/dy nudges (in grid units). Lines follow their station order; `via` adds bends between two consecutive stations that are not themselves on the straight line.
